description: Tells the two counters apart (MCPWARP.md §2.6 OVERLOADED re-send, §3.2 Transient retry, §6A.7 Backoff counter): the first registered is all-transient (alpha INTERNAL, beta TIMEOUT), so the group goes connecting + RETRYING (G3), the names stay pending and the transient counter's first re-send waits 1000 ms. That re-send is dropped by OVERLOADED: the OVERLOADED counter is its own, so this first OVERLOADED backs off 1000 ms (n = 1) whatever the transient streak, and a second consecutive one 2000 ms (n = 2). A shared counter would give 2000 and 4000. The third send is answered with both names in services[] and the group goes online.
